# Brad Sitzer

> Brad Sitzer is a Governance Trainer in Cape Town. He helps groups run meetings where every voice is heard, works on youth education and inclusive innovation (Mitchells Plain, Khayelitsha and Muizenberg), and is involved with Techmission, Grace2Learn and the Duneside Boro residency and micro-church in Muizenberg.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bradsitzer.co.za/): Biography, projects, education and contact details for Brad Sitzer.
- [Brad & Tia's Dice Ride](https://bradsitzer.co.za/dice-ride/): A dice-driven road trip game from Tokai to a one-night stay.
- [Ring Swipe](https://bradsitzer.co.za/ring-swipe/): A swipe game for wedding and engagement ring ideas that produces a ring brief for a Cape Town jeweller.
- [PowerWalk: Move the Neighbourhood](https://bradsitzer.co.za/powerwalk/): A 3D community organising game. Lead neighbours with one demand, listen and pitch using Nonviolent Communication and sociocracy principles.

## Organisations

- [Techmission](https://techmission.co.za/): Digital marketing company creating income opportunities for youth, plus leadership coaching.
- [Grace2Learn](https://grace2learn.co.za/): Non-profit learning development hub, with a learning hub in Mitchells Plain (2017 to 2022).

## Education

- BSc and Honours in Electrical Engineering, University of Cape Town (2006)
- Higher certificate in Life Coaching (2015)
- Masters in Philosophy in Inclusive Innovation, UCT Graduate School of Business (2020)
